title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 47
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 47: the short word concerning the Philistines, the waters out of the north and the sword of Yahweh.

questions.text: This word of Yahweh came concerning which people?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 47:1 says this was Yahweh's word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines.

questions.text: The word came before which event?
questions.explanation: It came before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

questions.text: From which direction do the waters rise up?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream.

questions.text: What will those waters become and do?
questions.explanation: They will become an overflowing stream and will overflow the land and all that is in it, the city and those who dwell in it.

answers.text: An overflowing stream that overflows the land and the city
A quiet pool of water beside the city wall
A dry riverbed in the valley below the city
A wall of water that protects the city

questions.text: What will the men and the inhabitants of the land do?
questions.explanation: The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.

answers.text: They will sing in the streets of the city
They will flee away to the land of Egypt
They will gather themselves for battle
The men will cry and all the inhabitants will wail

questions.text: Why do the fathers not look back to their children?
questions.explanation: At the noise of the hoofs, the chariots and the rumbling wheels, the fathers do not look back to their children for feebleness of hands.

answers.text: Because the children have already fled
Because they are far away in Egypt

questions.text: What will be cut off from Tyre and Sidon?
questions.explanation: The day comes to destroy all the Philistines and to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains.

questions.text: The Philistines are called the remnant of what?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.
Baldness has come on Gaza, and Ashkelon is brought to nothing.

questions.text: Against what has Yahweh appointed his sword?
questions.explanation: The chapter asks how the sword can be quiet, since Yahweh has given it a command: against Ashkelon and against the seashore he has appointed it.

answers.text: Against Ashkelon and against the seashore
